dps.description: Native six-class distinguished-point records with job_id, walker, steps, x, y, a, b.

statement: Research demonstration of a native six-class distinguished-point checker on a fresh isolated-custody secp256k1 ECDLP target. Public job SHA-256: 81bd38d6e82cc3f04428e770835539a06832e6a2c2850cfd844366f1a07c99eb. The private scalar is outside this repository. A valid DP proves the class key and aG+bQ equation, not recovery of the scalar or attack feasibility. This example is not a funded external prize. Walker provenance requires sampled re-walk auditing.
